name: Centralized ai

subjectOf.text: Centralizing data in a single repository, while it permits powerful computation and advanced algorithms, poses significant privacy risks and creates a single point of failure.
subjectOf.abstract: However, this centralization can pose significant privacy risks and create a single point of failure.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4941807
scope_conditions: in centralized AI architectures that pool data into one repository

subjectOf.text: Centralized AI structures for monitoring AI agents create a self referential loop that is prone to systemic biases and blind spots, and their rigidity prevents adaptation to the dynamic nature of AI.
subjectOf.abstract: Centralized AI structures for AI agent monitoring create a self-referential loop prone to systemic biases and blind spots, while their rigidity fails to adapt to AI's dynamic nature.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: centralized AI systems used to supervise AI agents

subjectOf.text: Claims that centralized AI ensures KYC and AML compliance are circular, because they rely on AI to interpret the very regulations that AI may itself violate.
subjectOf.abstract: the assertion that centralized AI ensures compliance with KYC and AML standards overlooks the circularity of relying on AI to interpret regulations it may itself violate.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: AI driven compliance interpretation for KYC and AML

subjectOf.text: The adaptive learning touted as the strength of centralized AI monitoring is insufficient, because it relies on internal data loops that cannot match the external evolution of AI agents.
subjectOf.abstract: The centralized AI adaptive learning touted as a strength is insufficient, as it relies on internal data loops that cannot match AI agents' external evolution.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: centralized feedback and recalibration confined to internal data
